title: Source service error
description: Body of every non-2xx response of the source service (plan 14.3, 15.3, 18.1). code is a stable machine-readable reason the client maps to a next step; message is for diagnostics and never contains secrets, tokens, file paths, titles or note text. retry_after_seconds accompanies 429 (rate_limited) and 503 (preparing: a manifest still being prepared) and mirrors the Retry-After header, so it is a whole number of seconds, not milliseconds: the HTTP header's unit, an exception to the units rule of Contracts/README.md.

code.description: Known codes: unsupported_protocol_version, not_found, method_not_allowed, invalid_id, invalid_request, invalid_cursor, invalid_part_size, token_in_query_forbidden, browser_origin_forbidden, unauthenticated, insufficient_scope, forbidden, invitation_invalid, invitation_expired, invitation_used, source_mismatch, pairing_denied, approval_timeout, rate_limited, payload_too_large, precondition_required, invalid_precondition, precondition_failed, invalid_range, multiple_ranges_unsupported, range_not_satisfiable, receipt_conflict, source_unavailable, source_changing, preparing, empty_file, item_too_large, internal_error. Clients treat unknown codes by HTTP status.
